summary: Raster redesign uses a bounded spawned page pool; vision stays in the parent context and sealed analysis remains deterministic.
invariants: Default worker cap is min(4, cpu count minus one); RASTER_ANALYSIS_PROCESS_WORKERS=0 selects it.
Vision clients and tenant runtime context remain in the parent process.
Page timing receipts are imported from workers; timing fields stay outside the sealed digest.
forbidden: Passing provider clients or tenant context objects into spawned workers.
